title: BB(10) > Graham's Number
summary: This GitHub repository presents a proof that BB(10) (the Busy Beaver number for 10-state Turing machines) exceeds Graham's Number, one of the largest well-defined numbers in mathematics. It documents a specific Turing machine configuration that demonstrates this remarkable result, pushing the boundaries of computability theory.
problem_solved: Demonstrates that a 10-state Turing machine can execute more steps than Graham's Number before halting, establishing a new lower bound for BB(10).
why_valuable: This proof significantly extends our understanding of computational limits and establishes a concrete lower bound for BB(10) using a number far larger than Graham's Number, which has implications for understanding the boundaries of provability and computability.
